YAADON MEIN RIKT STHAAN Watch

Empty Spaces in Memory

38 min Documentary India

A personal documentary about home, memory and a village changing beneath the memories of those who lived there. A quiet conversation between a grandmother and grandson traces what's lost — and what stays — as the places we call home slowly disappear.

Social Impact Films

Mera Safar — Story of a Transwoman

Part of the Mera Safar anthology on youth struggles and dreams. Follows Ayushi's journey of self-discovery and identity as a transwoman.

Mera Safar, Episode 2 — Ajay Ki Kahaani

The second film in the Mera Safar series. Traces Ajay's story — a young boy fighting circumstance to chase his aspirations.

Mera Safar, Episode 3 — Pooja Ki Kahani

The third film in the Mera Safar series. Follows Pooja, a young girl navigating hardship in pursuit of her dreams.

A Film on Tanda! — #RiseUp! Phase IV, YWCA

A ground-level documentary from Tanda, made under YWCA's RiseUp! Phase IV programme. Captures grassroots voices and community change.

RiseUp! Phase IV Implementation, Year 1 — Compilation Film

A compilation documenting the first year of RiseUp! Phase IV on the ground. Brings together stories of impact across partner communities.

Majhi Vasundhara — Building a Net-Zero Maharashtra

Documents Maharashtra's Majhi Vasundhara Abhiyaan and its drive toward a net-zero future. Explores the state's climate role as an Under2 Coalition member.

Dastan-e-Parwaz

A cinematic "tale of flight" — a documentary short exploring aspiration, ambition, and the journey of rising above circumstance.
